headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the 03:15 edition the war’s most volatile sectors have intensified. Weathered Expanse now records 34 ownership changes in the last 24 hours, pushing casualties to 178,306 Colonial and 196,114 Warden while both casualty rates and enlistments accelerate. Mooring County has erupted with three flips in the past two hours and a 24‑hour toll of 22,816 Colonial and 18,586 Warden dead, marking a new flashpoint. Farranac Coast remains restless, logging nine flips in the last day and a split of one Warden base to nine Colonial, losses at 47,593 Colonial and 58,864 Warden. Stonecradle stays hot with 14 flips in 24 hours centred on World’s End, Buckler Sound and The Reach, casualties climbing to 61,266 Colonial and 78,009 Warden. Linn Mercy continues to churn, nine flips around Lathair in the past day, totals 54,682 Colonial and 69,062 Warden, recruitment still rising. Fishermans Row, quiet in the prior report, has surged to fourteen flips in 24 hours — Black Well, Dankana Post, Arcadia and Eidolo the busiest posts — bringing its count to 11,557 Colonial and 13,891 Warden dead. Northern Warden‑held sectors and rear areas show no ownership changes.
